en: "...No. Not just yet."{w}
"What's that supposed to mean, Zeshrom?{w}Don't tell me you're planning to break our contract."{w}
"That is not it. I am saying it is not over yet."{w}

"...Lady Urna,
is that all your wrath and your bitterness amount to?"{w}
"Huh?"{w}

"Why do you think
these two divine relics
remained in your hands?"{w}{p}"Contrachio did not reject
everything that you are.{w}So long as you hold the relics, there is still a chance."{w}

"Anyone can simply lament.
But you had the will to stand back up.{w}That is why I placed my hopes in you."{w}
"Zeshrom..."{w}
"...Rise again, as many times as it takes.{w}I, too, shall lend you my aid."{w}
"Tch. Had to go and pull a stunt like that, didn't you..."{w}
"That's right, I... I will fight...{w}I will never give up..."{w}{p}"The power of this Sword of Wrath...{w}and of the Earring of Sorrow...{w}here and now, I release it!"{w}
"The Earth Mother... is ME!{w}It must be me and no other!!"{w}
Urna closed her eyes and called out in a clear, commanding voice.{w}

"My name is Urna.
The New Land, Urnas Rade."{w}
note: Urunasu Rade: romanized 'Urnas Rade' after Finas Rade (fiinasu raade); the glossary has only Urna Rade (uruna raade). New name. 2769/2771 look like alternative versions of the same line.

en:
"My name is Urna.
Urna-Zefkaka."{w}

"Though the wall of time may stand between us,
you, of all things, I must never forget."{w}{p}"Light of wisdom, bright as the long ages,
and its keeper, great elder of the sky: Omsis of Wind."{w}{p}"Flame of the heart that never dies out,
and its keeper, overlord of the hellfire: Rades of Fire."{w}{p}"Ripple of life that drifts in the deep,
and its keeper, noble of the waters: Shirins of Water."{w}{p}"And..."{w}{p}"Firm foundation that upholds all things,
and its keeper, child of the earth: Raizas of Earth."{w}{p}"Come to me!!"{w}
note: Urna calls the Four Sages by their former names (glossary: Omsis, Rades, Shirins, Raizas). 'X, tsukasadorishi Y, Z' rendered 'X, and its keeper, Y: Z'. Hoshi-shimo (stars and frost) = the long years -> 'the long ages'.

en: Urna's body was enveloped in a dazzling light.{w}

As if answering Urna's call,
a single beast appeared before you.{w}
note: Rows 2775-2778 are variants by beast count (1-4), presumably by how many Sages the party restored.

en:
As if answering Urna's call,
two beasts appeared before you.{w}

As if answering Urna's call,
three beasts appeared before you.{w}

As if answering Urna's call,
four beasts appeared before you.{w}

As if answering Urna's call,
four beasts appeared before you.{w}{p}There stood the ancient Earth Mother, a being to be held in dread.{w}The hour of judgment begins.{w}
note: Danzai (condemnation) = 'judgment', echoing Urna's 'sword of judgment' line (2724). Present tense kept from the source.

en: "I won't... accept... this...{w}That's... right... isn't it...?{w}Fa...ther... Sari...jana..."{w}{p}"It won't... end... like this...{w}It will never... EN... D...{w}Gu... GYAAAAAAAAAAAAAGH!!"{w}
note: Sarijana's honorific dropped per the lead's convention (gender not established). 'Sou... deshou...?' read as Urna appealing to Father/Sarijana: 'That's... right... isn't it...?' (she seeks their agreement). Katakana OWARA...NA (voice breaking into monster) rendered in caps 'EN... D...'.

en:
A vortex of immense power arose,
swallowing everything, Urna and the Kin of Darkness alike.{w}Something had been left behind in its wake.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Earth Fragment.{w}
note: New item name: daichi no kakera -> 'Earth Fragment' (EBOOT item table eb@089504a8 untranslated).

en:
There is an inscription.{w}{p}Mysterious numbers are carved into its surface.{w}{p}{0E}              *  712612.301  *              

    61043891  >{0F}{w}
note: Full-width digits/symbols converted to ASCII; layout re-centred to the 22-full-width-char line (44 columns). Numbers kept verbatim (likely a land/system number, cf. "Rade 301 system").

en: "Now then, what brings you here?{w}This is no place for the likes of you."{w}{p}"Sorry, but would you kindly go back home?{w}If you won't, I'll see you home by force."{w}
Go back?
"Off with you, quickly now."{w}
"Don't hurt the Princess any more than you already have!!"{w}
note: Himesama = 'the Princess' (Four Sages' form of address for Urna, as Raizam's 'Princess' in slice 031).

en: "Y-you're a strong lot, aren't you...{w}But you're still leaving the Princess's land!!"{w}

"Oh, oh!{w}So you've remembered the Princess, have you?{w}Even so..."{w}{p}"It must have been terribly hard on the Princess, too.{w}She won't see anyone but us."{w}{p}"And this time, I must protect this land
no matter what.{w}I can't leave it."{w}

"Thanks to you folks,
the Princess has finally found some peace.{w}Truly, thank you."{w}
There is an altar.{w}
*  Dukes' Territory  *

note: Event title nageki no houkou -> 'Roar of Lament' (new). Banner padded to 46 columns like earlier slices.

en:
Suddenly, sand and dust swirled into the air.{w}From within the dust cloud, a misshapen dragon appeared.{w}{p}Its eyes were painted over with rage, sorrow and regret,
and you were at the mercy of the storm.{w}
*  Prince's Territory  *
note: Purinsu Teritorii -> 'Prince's Territory' (new; singular to mirror Dukes' Territory).
Glossary note gives this event name as "The Proud House Lenzer".

en: *  Refugee Camp  *
note: Refyujii Kyanpu -> 'Refugee Camp' (new).
Event title (lit. 'the wandering two who are not forgiven') -> 'Two Unforgiven Wanderers' (new).

en: "Sis, what about this place?"{w}
note: Neesan here is the speaker's actual sister (siblings); 'Sis'. Name boxes Boy's Voice / Girl's Voice per glossary; identity not stated.

en:
"It's a beautiful land.{w}But it seems
it won't accept bodies like ours."{w}
"I guess we have to keep traveling after all."{w}
"Yes. But first, the enemy in front of us."{w}
Hoarse Voice
note: Shiwagareta koe -> 'Hoarse Voice' (new name box, 12 chars). Speaker presumably the Grand Chancellor (room banner 3778), not stated; no pronouns used.

en: "You know nothing yet.{w}You do not even know that you know nothing.{w}So allow me to teach you."{w}{p}"...that an adventure too far will cost you your life."{w}
"What do you lot want!?{w}I don't even want to see your faces. Get out!!"{w}
"Princess~"{w}
"...Y-you lot!?{w}Raizam, what's the meaning of this!?"{w}{p}"How dare you come waltzing in here and show your faces!{w}I don't even want to look at you. Go home!!"{w}
Urna tried to blast you out of the place!{w}

"Please wait, mogu!{w}Look at what these kids brought
for you, Princess, mogu!!"{w}
"Huh!? What are you talking about!?{w}Whatever you bring me now, it won't... huh?{w}Is that... Yuan Wine...?"{w}
"What's going on...{w}Why do you lot have this..."{w}

note: Chokumei = 'royal command' (Leafa is a princess). Ogre/Goblin lowercased as common nouns in narration.

en: "There were others... who remembered me too?{w}What... that's... that's not fair..."{w}{p}"You lot...{w}I thought... I'd never forgive you...{w}It's not fair... Waaaaaaahhh!"{w}

Hundreds, thousands of years--no, tens or hundreds of thousands...{w}How long must Urna have spent
in solitude?{w}{p}Because the days she had lost
had been so full of happiness.{w}{p}There was Urna, sobbing like a child.{w}The Earth Mother, scorned as an ancient evil spirit,
who had seen those she loved turn their blades on her.{w}{p}You and Urna had forgiven each other.{w}And now, after a long and painful journey,
you and Urna are at last trying to win something back.{w}
note: Page 2 is a deliberate fragment (the reason her solitude was so hard) - kept as one. Last sentence: subject carried over from 'You and Urna' -> 'you', but it could be Urna alone reclaiming something; uncertain. | Accuracy: last sentence restores the compound subject carried from the previous sentence (kimitachi to Urna): "you and Urna are at last trying...", so it no longer reads as the party alone.

en: "*Sniff*... *sniff*...{w}
note: Quote left open on purpose: the next row (3860) redraws this text in {0E}..{0F} and closes the quote, so a closing quote here would vanish on redraw (same approach as slice 007).

en:
{0E}"*Sniff*... *sniff*...{0F}
But I still won't forgive you."{w}
"Why, mogu!?{w}They worked so hard, mogu! Forgive them, moguuu!"{w}

"N-O!{w}I mean, these kids
tried to kill me, you know!?"{w}

"Says you, Princess, when you were
trying to turn the whole land upside down!"{w}
note: Raizam has no mogu in this line in the source; none added.

en: "That's that.{w}And this is this."{w}
"...You're so unfair, Princess, mogu."{w}
"Shut uuup!"{w}
"MOGEEEH!?{w}Not the nose, you can't grab my nose, mogeeeh!?"{w}

"Listen up!{w}If you want me to forgive you, chase off the Kin of Darkness
that have invaded this land!"{w}{p}"Do that, and I'll accept this wine."{w}

"W-well, if that's what you want,
you could've just asked them nor"{w}
note: Source cuts off mid-word (futsuu ni onegai sureba i-) as Urna grabs Raizam's nose: English cut at the same point ('asked them nor[mally]').

en: "MOGEEEH!{w}MOGEGEEEH!?"{w}
"Then I'll for-give-you~"{w}
Urna gave you a friendly wink.{w}...The ancient evil spirit.{w}
note: Wry narrator aside, kept as the bare noun phrase like the source (no added 'so much for').

en: "So that's settled. Go take out the Demon Dukes. I'm counting on you!"{w}
note: Daimakou taiji read as plural 'the Demon Dukes': next slice (3904) has 'you beat all the Demon Dukes'.

en: "Counting on you, moguuu!"{w}

"That stone tablet over there
still doesn't have a start time on it, mogu."{w}
note: Kaishi jikoku = 'start time' (Urna's 'start stamp' line in slice 031 is the related kaishi no kokuin, which recurs in 3894).

en: "Who cares about that stupid thing."{w}
